name: openvas-scanner
description_en: This repository contains the scanner component for Greenbone Community Edition.
readme_excerpt: OpenVAS Scanner This is the OpenVAS Scanner of the Greenbone Community Edition. It is used for the Greenbone Enterprise appliances and is a full-featured scan engine that executes a continuously updated and extended feed of Vulnerability Tests (VTs). Releases All release files are signed with the Greenbone Community Feed integrity key.
